artifact_retention: Pull and review promptly; keep this run's private input/output prefixes at most 30 days without renewed storage approval.
authorization: Draft only: the user's explicit approval must name this SHA256 and cover its private uploads, one job and bounded storage
scope_exclusions: final/BIRD evaluation (B only, by its own registration, if dev >= 38/95)

forecast.basis: A1500's 368.4 input tokens/s and ~1.8 h dev screen on the same t4-small

decision_rule: B joins the final evaluation by its own registration only if its dev strict is at least 38/95; A+ is a control and never a finalist; B vs A+ is reported paired and descriptive
pass_criteria: account, rate, pins and private upload verified; every training and dev reference passes
continuation starts from the pinned A1500 adapter with the frozen matched data and settings
40 finite updates, none skipped; exact reload of the final adapter
95 dev episodes with one finite projected position; AuditKIT agrees with every score
abort_criteria: wrong account or higher hardware price
missing memory measurement, full-prompt inference projection or AuditKIT disagreement
